sample_data.reset_instructions: Run `python -m seed.seed_data` or execute `python harness.py P08_school_results_public.json` to load and test fixtures.

problem_solving_method: Built a modular, pure-Python deterministic rule engine (app/rules.py) decoupled from database layers for auditable, transparent grading calculation. Paired with a FastAPI REST backend and Ext JS frontend grid providing complete traceability, real-time recalculation, and 3-tier prioritized verification checking lists (R-29).

R1.evidence: app/rules.py:evaluate_subject, tests/test_rules.py (R1-R5 grading bands and component failure rules R11, R12)

R2.evidence: app/rules.py:evaluate_student (GPA computation, 4th optional subject bonus calculation, 5.00 capping, G1-G5 rules, R13)

R3.evidence: app/services.py:get_checking_lists, report.py:lists, web/app.js (Three R-29 checking lists: optional <=2.0, practical fail <8, absent AB, with 3 priority tiers)

R4.evidence: web/index.html, web/app.js, app/main.py (Ext JS dashboard with student list, full transparent per-subject rule trace modal, live compute endpoint, verification checklist CSV export)

team_members.major_contribution: Rule engine design, FastAPI endpoints, checking list categorization, Ext JS front-end integration, automated test suites and test harness.
Backend and database architecture, rule engine verification, testing, and deployment configuration.

major_design_decisions: Pure Python core rule engine with zero DB/framework dependencies allowing offline CLI and test-driven verification without infrastructure.
Explicit rule codes (R1-R5, G1-G5) attached to every student subject and overall grade calculation for complete auditable traceability.
Priority-tiered office verification list (Priority 1: Critical outcome changers, Priority 2: Rule applications/withheld, Priority 3: Routine numeric shifts).
Dual interface support: Ext JS interactive web UI + rich CLI reports (report.py) and CLI JSON fixture tester (harness.py).
known_limitations: Vercel serverless deployment runs SQLite in read-only mode (full interactive compute/write available in local environment or with Postgres DATABASE_URL).

ai_tools_used.used_for: Boilerplate structuring, test generation, documentation and verification harness creation
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Verified with pytest suite (tests/test_rules.py), edge case CLI trace reports (report.py), and public fixture testing (harness.py)
